description: This file is a C/C header file ('web_sato_exported_api.h') that declares prototypes for exported functions related to a Web Status Atom Table component. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the object, and contains licensing and documentation comments.

methods.name: WebCreateStatusAtomTable
methods.description: Creates a new Status Atom Table object with provided container and owner contexts.

methods.name: WebSatoCreate
methods.description: Creates the main Web Status Atom Table object with specified contexts.

methods.name: WebSatoRemove
methods.description: Removes or destroys the Web Status Atom Table object.

methods.name: WebSatoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects within the Web Status Atom Table.

methods.name: WebSatoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Web Status Atom Table object.
